results.description:
The Gratitude app is a carefully-designed self-care tool to help you focus on your mental health.

With a gratitude journal, affirmations, vision board, and daily motivation content, Gratitude provides you with all the tools and reminders you need to gain motivation and develop a healthy self-love routine in your life. 
 
To live a happy and fulfilling life, it is important for us to have good mental health and a strong sense of self-love.

And, as the app is completely private, you can always be assured that your precious journal entries, affirmations, and vision board are for your eyes only.

Here are the tools that you will find in the Gratitude app:

1. GRATITUDE JOURNAL

A gratitude journal or diary opens up your eyes to reflect on all the little blessings in your life.

In daily life, we can lose sight of what we are fortunate to have and by keeping a journal you can slowly and steadily shift your perspective to focus on what is good in your life.

The Gratitude app will send you reminders with prompts to help you build the habit of journaling.

You can also add photos to your journal entries and can record journals in your voice, build a gratitude journal streak, and access hundreds of journal prompts. 

2. POSITIVE AFFIRMATIONS

If you’ve heard about manifestation or the law of attraction, you’ve probably heard about affirmations.

Positive daily affirmations change our self-talk to focus on more loving and kind thoughts towards ourselves.

They give us the motivation we need to keep moving forward and believe in ourselves.

The Gratitude app has hundreds of affirmations that you can listen to or read, as per your need.

You can also write your own affirmations, add music, and record your voice to them.

Positive affirmations are a dearly loved tool and with this affirmations app, it is very easy for you to practice them.

3. CREATE VISION BOARDS

Another super popular manifestation tool is a vision board, also called a dream board. The vision board serves as a collage of your dreams and goals in the form of photos, quotes, and affirmations.

In the Gratitude app, we’ll help you make a great vision board using sections, goal ideas, and create a video of all your goals together with music. You can also make multiple vision boards!

4. DAILY ZEN

We understand the need for motivation and inspiration as you build a healthy routine with these self-help tools, which is why Daily Zen is an important part of the app.

Here, you will find gratitude quotes, motivation quotes, thought switch ideas, thank you cards, affirmations, blog articles, and real-life stories of people who changed their mindset with gratitude.

5. MINDFUL MINUTES

We define the Mindful minutes as the time that you spend in the Gratitude app. You can view the mindful minutes under 'All Health Data' section in the Health app provided by Apple. Currently, the app does not read any data from the health app. We don't write any data in the health app without your consent. You can turn on the mindful minutes from the profile & settings in the Gratitude app.

results.description:
Adopting a grateful attitude is one of the most powerful things you can do to create positive changes within your life. Gratitude has the power to energize, the power to heal and the power to bring hope. Research has shown that practicing gratitude regularly can help boost feelings of happiness and increase your well-being.

Gratitude Jar is a simple gratitude journal that easily helps you cultivate gratitude by reflecting on what you are thankful for each day and allowing you to be more present. Sometimes it’s the simple things that make life wonderful – an encouraging text from a friend, watching your plant grow or even a random act of kindness from a stranger. When you take just a few minutes to reflect on your day, you might be surprised to see even a not so great day may turn out to be an amazing one!

Sometimes you just need a small reminder for all the things – big or small you have done. Our world is full of things to be grateful for – Gratitude Jar helps you notice, appreciate, and share your gratitude. Add a daily dose of gratitude to your day! 


 FEATURES:

- Jar Shake: Whenever you just need a reminder of the good things in your life, you can use the Jar Shake feature which displays a random memory from your previous gratitude entries. Additionally, each star represents entries you have made, so slowly watch as the number of stars fill the jar with the more entries you write.

- Streaks: Keep track of your personal progress with a calendar view and streak to keep your momentum going. Build a mindful gratitude journaling habit.

- Gratitude Log: Look back and cherish your previous gratitude entries. You have the option of searching by keywords or date and by tapping on an entry, it allows you to edit it. 

- Reminders: Set daily notifications to help you turn gratitude into a daily habit.

- Share Your Gratitude: Expressing gratitude can be fun, why not share your gratitude with your loved ones and show your appreciation with those you are grateful for.

- Dark Mode: Dark mode is great for late night mindful journaling and helps improve sleep quality without glare from your phone.

- Ad-free space for you to reflect on things you are grateful for.


WE RESPECT YOUR PRIVACY:

We do not store any of your data, and we do not require you to sign-in or make an account. We built this gratitude journal with your privacy in mind.


“Gratitude helps you to grow and expand; gratitude brings joy and laughter into your life and into the lives of all those around you.”

- Eileen Caddy

Gratitude Journal is a simple, private daily journal designed to turn gratitude and mindful reflection into a gentle self-care practice.

Taking a few quiet minutes to reflect on the good in your life can help you feel happier, nurture positive emotions, and support your mental well-being over time.

This is not about pretending that every day is wonderful. It is about training your mind to notice that even on difficult days, something meaningful may still be there.

A kind message. The first sip of something warm. Sunlight on the wall. A small win no one else noticed. The quiet relief of simply making it through a difficult day.

These moments can be easy to miss. Gratitude Journal gives them a place to stay.


NOTICE MORE OF THE GOOD

Write down something that made you smile, a person you felt grateful for, a small achievement, a peaceful moment, or anything that made the day feel a little lighter.

As your journal grows, those small entries become a personal collection of happiness, appreciation, and meaningful memories—a reminder that more good has been happening than you may have realized.

BUILD A POSITIVE MINDSET—WITHOUT THE PRESSURE

There are no streaks to protect, no scores to improve, and no pressure to be positive every day. Skip a day. Miss a week. Come back when you are ready.

Your progress is not erased just because life became busy.

A GENTLE DAILY RHYTHM

Set an optional daily reminder for a time that feels right for you.

Use it as a quiet invitation to pause, practice mindfulness, and reflect on something good—not as another task demanding your attention.

Over time, this small daily self-care habit can help you become more aware of positive moments while they are happening, not only when you look back.

MISS A DAY? THE MOMENT IS STILL YOURS

Choose any past date to save a moment you want to remember. Gratitude Journal also helps you notice days you may want to return to, making it easy to fill in meaningful memories whenever they come back to you.

WRITE WITHOUT INTERRUPTION

Every entry is organized by date in a calm, simple timeline. Look back through previous moments, add another thought, or return to edit an earlier day whenever you like.

PRIVATE, OFFLINE, AND YOURS

Reminders are scheduled locally and never use the words you have written. You can also export your journal as a text file whenever you want your own copy.

WHAT YOU CAN DO

• Create a simple daily gratitude practice
• Save one or many good moments each day
• Support a happier, more positive mindset
• Make mindfulness and reflection part of your self-care routine
• Write freely with automatic saving
• Browse meaningful memories in a simple timeline
• Keep your private diary on your device
• Use the journal offline and without an account
• Export your writing as a file
• Journal without streaks, guilt, or social pressure

Some moments change your life.

Others simply make it a little softer.

Both are worth remembering.

Begin with one small good thing today.

Punkt is the German word for punctuation mark. Punkt makes journaling secure, private, easy and fun. But the best of starting a journal now is that you become a happier person.

Punkt's focus is on a simple design. Your stories are the most important part of the app, so why should we distract you with any other complicated stuff?

Punkt saves your stories on your local device and in your private iCloud. No one but you can read your stories. You can also protect your stories with Face ID or Touch ID.

* ACCESSIBILITY *
Punkt supports dynamic type, voice-over and voice control. It is designed to be used by everyone. I would welcome any feedback regarding accessibility as this is truly important to me.

Punkt is developed just by one developer, therefore I want to make really fair and transparent pricing. If Punkt makes you just a little bit happier, you can help to contribute that the app stays independent and does not need to display ads or require personal data.

---------------

This app will help you be happier!  It pushes you to think about what has gone right in your day, which has been shown to increase happiness.  Every time you note down what good things have happened (and there is always something), you receive points you can use to build up a garden and also a Gratitude Card with suggestions for further things you could do to increase your gratitude and happiness.  

Research shows that one of the most effective ways that people can become happier is to note down the good things that happen every day.  This shifts our focus onto what has gone right, rather than leaving us to ruminate about problems.

There is a huge amount of research indicating that the act of recalling and writing down what has gone well each day is one of the best way to increase your happiness.  One study found that gratitude journaling for ten weeks increased happiness by 25% over the people who didn't keep a gratitude journal.  Gratitude is also linked to high self-esteem, kindness, good health, energy and generosity.
  
The Gratitude Garden was designed by Izzy McRae, a coach and happiness teacher.  You can find out more information about her and her courses at www.izzymcrae.com. Neville Sattentau produced the beautiful artwork.  His website is www.nevart.co.uk.

results.description:
Three good things a day. That's the whole idea.

Calluna is a journal for small joys — the coffee in the sun, the message you didn't expect, the bread still warm from the bakery. You write them down, and a plant grows.

WHAT YOU DO EACH DAY
• One tap for your mood, on five gentle levels. Even a hard day makes the plant grow.
• One to three good things, if you feel like it. Never required.
• A hint when you're stuck ("Did you eat something good today?"), a reason if you want to say why, a category, the people who were there.
• One photo, from your library or taken on the spot.

WHAT GROWS
One plant a month. Your mood sets how fast it grows, and each good thing opens a flower. Nothing dies, nothing goes backwards. A day you skip is simply a day without growth — no broken streak, no guilt.
At the end of the month the plant joins your garden: twelve plants a year, side by side. Your year in joy, without a single chart.

WHEN THE DAY IS GREY
On a hard day, Calluna offers — never forces — a happy memory drawn from your own journal. It avoids the last few days and favours the brightest ones. You can also ask for one at any time.

LOOKING BACK
• The happiness bank: everything you've written, to reread or to draw at random.
• The calendar: a month of moods at a glance, and more good days than you remembered.
• Sunday's bouquet: the week's joys gathered in one place.
• "A year ago today", quietly, on the home screen.

WHAT CALLUNA WILL NEVER ASK
There is no field for what went wrong. No mood curve sloping down. No streak you mustn't break. And no account to create — no email address, no password. You open the app and you write.

YOUR JOURNAL STAYS ON YOUR PHONE
It lives on your device. We don't read it, because we don't have it. If you want a copy, you choose: back it up to your own Google Drive, or export everything — words and photos — into a single .zip file you can open anywhere, with or without Calluna. Nothing is sold, nothing is passed on.

Available in English, French, German, Spanish, Italian and Portuguese.
